title: Tracing and Monitoring
summary: This module provides core functionalities for tracing execution runs, managing their lifecycle, and integrating with logging and streaming mechanisms. It enables detailed observation and analysis of component interactions within an application.

nodes.label: Collect Run Traces
nodes.title: Collect Run Traces Context
nodes.description: Provides a context manager to gather and manage execution traces during runtime, allowing detailed inspection of the execution flow and run activities.

nodes.label: Manage Core Tracing Logic
nodes.title: Abstract Tracer Core
nodes.description: Abstract base class defining the fundamental structure and methods for all tracers. It handles run creation, updates, and error logging for various component types like LLMs, Chains, Tools, and Retrievers.

nodes.label: Process Asynchronous Stream Logs
nodes.title: Asynchronous Stream Consumer
nodes.description: Asynchronously consumes streamed output from a runnable, generates JSON patches for incremental updates, and sends them as `RunLogPatch` events for real-time monitoring and logging.

nodes.label: Log Run Events
nodes.title: Logging Callback Handler
nodes.description: A concrete callback handler that processes various events (e.g., text output) from execution runs and directs them to a specified Python logger, including contextual breadcrumbs.

groups.label: Tracing Context Management
groups.title: Tracing Context Management
groups.description: Components responsible for setting up and managing the context in which execution runs are traced.

groups.label: Core Tracing Abstraction
groups.title: Core Tracing Abstraction
groups.description: The foundational abstract class that defines the common interface and logic for all tracing implementations.

groups.label: Event Processing & Logging
groups.title: Event Processing & Logging
groups.description: Components that process and react to tracing events, including handling streaming data and integrating with standard logging systems.
